items.title: Define the Layer 2 unlock scope and non-claims
items.context: The document must clearly distinguish Engineering Baseline proof from Development baseline, Loop Engineering, Production Safety, and Capability Claim. It should state what can and cannot be claimed after unlock.
items.userSees: The execution document explains the Layer 2 unlock boundary and prevents overclaiming.

items.title: Specify executable ENG baseline evidence and gates
items.context: The document must define concrete ENG baseline run order, expected outcomes, required artifacts, fail-closed rules, multi-host roles, and pass/block criteria. Risky migration/security baselines must allow only expected block or gated pass with evidence.
items.userSees: The execution document gives future agents enough detail to run and audit the ENG baseline suite.

items.title: Define the operational runbook for formal unlock
items.context: The document must provide a usable step-by-step runbook: preflight, contract freeze, baseline execution, audit, suite evaluation, claim authorization, and rollback/block handling. It must preserve the four philosophical principles.
items.userSees: The execution document provides a practical sequence for formally unlocking Layer 2 without skipping proof.
